topic: What Happens When You Swallow Gum?

beats.narration: You've probably been told that swallowing gum stays in your stomach for 7 years... but is that actually true?

shots.scene_description: Stylized 3D boy swallowing a large pink bubble gum, wide shot in bright studio lighting.
Detailed anatomical 3D cutaway cross-section of pink gum sliding down the throat.

beats.narration: Saliva enzymes try to break it down, but the gum base completely resists. So your stomach acid steps in.

shots.scene_description: Microscopic 3D view of stomach acid churning around the pink gum mass.
Close up of intestinal muscles squeezing the gum intact.

beats.narration: Your digestive system treats it like insoluble fiber, passing it safely out of your body in just a few days!

shots.scene_description: Stylized 3D boy smiling happily in relief, bright studio lighting.
